note: Safe userspace delta: restore Stevia keyboard+native nav dock, add native in-app Back, remove network-online/network.target boot blockers, deploy optimized framebridge. No kernel, partition, modem, DTB or USB gadget mutation.
invariants: No write may resolve onto a raw partition block device, a BOOT/USERDATA/SYSTEM/RECOVERY/DTB/DTBO/VBMETA image, the radio/modem, EFS/SEC_EFS/calibration/IMEI/PIT or any partition metadata.
Every deploy target must live under an allowed userspace root (assert_userspace_path).
Stage -> verify SHA-256 -> atomic install -> restart the smallest affected service -> health check -> automatic rollback on failure.
Sources must resolve INSIDE this repository (no absolute path, no '..').

groups.component: Start native Stevia OSK + nuxel-navdock from the phone session
groups.health_check: systemctl is-active --quiet nuxel-wayland && grep -q 'starting A45 nav dock + Stevia OSK' /usr/lib/nuxel/nuxel-session.sh && grep -q 'phosh-osk-stevia' /usr/lib/nuxel/nuxel-session.sh

groups.component: Disable DOM keyboard fallback when Stevia provider is present; bump PWA cache
groups.health_check: test "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8000/pwa/nuxel-home/index.html)" = 200 && grep -q 'v51-pwnage-32000' /usr/share/nuxel/pwa/nuxel-home/sw.js && grep -q 'touch-keyboard.js?v=a83-pwnage32000' /usr/share/nuxel/pwa/nuxel-home/index.html && grep -q 'app.js?v=a83-pwnage32000' /usr/share/nuxel/pwa/nuxel-home/index.html && systemctl is-active --quiet nuxel-wayland

groups.component: Add native in-app Back, activate, and close-foreground bridge routes
groups.health_check: systemctl is-active --quiet nuxel-http-bridge && python3 -m py_compile /usr/lib/nuxel/nuxel-bridge/api.py && grep -q '/api/v1/apps/back' /usr/lib/nuxel/nuxel-bridge/api.py && curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/v1/ping >/dev/null

groups.component: Route short Back through the bridge for native apps and close native toplevel on long Back
Native browser control FIFO and can_go_back/can_go_forward state

groups.declared_reload: systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl restart nuxel-bridge.service nuxel-http-bridge.service nuxel-web.service && systemctl is-active nuxel-bridge.service nuxel-http-bridge.service nuxel-web.service
groups.health_check: systemctl is-active --quiet nuxel-bridge.service && systemctl is-active --quiet nuxel-http-bridge.service && systemctl is-active --quiet nuxel-web.service && ! grep -q '^After=.*network-online.target' /etc/systemd/system/nuxel-bridge.service && ! grep -q '^After=.*network.target' /etc/systemd/system/nuxel-web.service
groups.rollback: restore each <target>.nuxel-rollback, run systemctl daemon-reload, and restart the affected services

groups.component: Optimized nuxel-wl-fb blit (a67) to reduce frame-bridge latency
